messages:
alex: Heads up — staging embeddings service is seeing intermittent 503s on the long tail. I have a hotfix that reverts the recent kvcache tweak. Requesting expedited staging deploy + short smoke window, then quick prod push if green. Need one ops + one eng approval to bypass standard canary. /cc @ops-oncall-jay @tara-sre

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: release/embeds-hotfix@v3.2.1 -> staging. Required approvals: [ops, eng]. To approve: `approve deploy 1912345678` or click: https://deploy.local/1912345678

ops-oncall-jay: Can you paste rollback criteria and blast radius?

alex: Rollback plan: immediate abort if 5xx rate > 1% over any 5m window or p95 token latency increases > 200ms. If abort: `deploy rollback release/embeds-hotfix@v3.2.1 --env=staging`. Logs collected at `/infra/embeds/hotfix-1912345678`

maria: Have we pinned the model variant? Concerned the quant path could change behavior.

alex: Yes — pinned to `embed-small-quant8`. Image tag: `gcr.io/redwood/embeds:embed-hotfix-v3.2.1-quant8`

eng-lead-sam: We need a quick smoke list before prod. Please post checklist.

alex: Smoke checklist:
- start 10k-token ingestion test (mini load)
- core API health endpoint returns 200 for 1m
- spot-check outputs for 3 sample prompts
- KV cache hit rate not degraded (compare to baseline)
- observability: token-latency/p95 and traces ok

pm-lena: Include a short release note blurb for customers: "Resolved intermittent 503s in embeddings service; no customer action required."

tara-sre: Ops approves expedited staging deploy. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall-jay: I approve as well. I want 10m of quiet metrics at low traffic before any prod shift. :white_check_mark:

alex: Roger. Triggering staging deploy now. Command:
```
/deploy release/embeds-hotfix@v3.2.1 --env=staging --skip-canary --tag=hotfix-1912345678
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/embeds-hotfix@v3.2.1 -> staging
- step 1: image pull
- step 2: drain old pods
- step 3: start new pods
link: https://deploy.local/1912345678/logs

releasebot: Release note draft saved: "embeds: fix intermittent 503s (v3.2.1)" — PM review requested @pm-lena

alex: Staging pods up. Running smoke tests now.

maria: 10k-token ingestion -> PASS. health endpoint 200. sample prompts look fine on quick spot check.

eng-lead-sam: KV cache hit rate steady vs baseline, no p95 regression.

ops-oncall-jay: Metrics quiet for 12 minutes, no spike. OK to prod shift. I'll monitor closely. :eyes:

alex: Initiating prod rollout: traffic-split strategy 2% -> 20% after 5m -> 100% after 15m if all green. Command:
```
/deploy release/embeds-hotfix@v3.2.1 --env=prod --traffic-split=2,20,100 --stagger=5m
```

deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Health hooks enabled, auto-rollback thresholds set to 1% 5xx and p95 +200ms.

maria: Early 2% slice looks stable. No errors.

pm-lena: Release note approved. Attaching to ticket RED-4521.

ops-oncall-jay: If any spike above thresholds I will abort and we will rollback. Otherwise :rocket:

alex: Thanks all — I'll post final confirmation when we hit 100% traffic.

tara-sre: Nice work, team. :tada:
